applicable_failures: The single os.walk call filtered by file name only (regex on filenames), so matters whose M&A documents have unhelpful names were not reached; no document-text search was run, which the stage policy requires.

The candidate list in the self-assessment (about 30 matters, e.g. 1001-00003, 1022-00006, 1046-00001) was hand-picked from the path output. Many other matters that surfaced (e.g. 1045-00004 to 00007, 1002-00002, 1004-00001, 1015-00005) were left off without a stated reason.
The output was long (about 16,700 characters, partly truncated) and the agent treated the visible part as the master list. It did not page through or re-run the search uncapped.
critique.concerns: The agent claims a goal reached with only one filename-regex call. The output was truncated, and no text-content search was done. Its shortlist drops many matters that appeared in the results. The terms it matched, such as term sheet and letter of intent, also pull in financing and settlement matters, and the agent never opened a document to confirm which were M&A. The candidate set is not yet reliable.
critique.recommendation: Re-run the path search and save the full result to a file, then page through it. Reconcile the shortlist against the full list. Add a document-text scan across all matters for M&A terms such as 'closing date' and 'signing', with capped, short snippets. Keep every matter that surfaced in either search as a candidate, and give a reason for each one excluded.
